newsitem.title: UK: BAe down again, still hit by Boeing results.
newsitem.headline: BAe down again, still hit by Boeing results.

text.p: Shares in British Aerospace Plc dipped in a sharply rising UK equity market on Tuesday amid further reaction to last week's disappointing first quarter results from Boeing Co, dealers said.

British Aerospace shares were down 6p at 12.90-1/2 stg by 1106 GMT in modest volume of 436,353 shares, even as the FTSE 100 index leapt 68.1 points to a record 4,523.7. In New York on Monday, shares in Boeing Co fell $5/8 to $100.
"There has been a lot of (BAe) stock washing around," said one market-maker, "Boeing came out with its earnings last week and BAe fell out of bed and there doesn't seem to be any recovery yet."
